text:
Atlanta e guzobere na 1837 dị ka Terminus, njedebe nke ụzọ ụgbọ okporo ígwè Western & Atlantic. A kpọgharịrị ya Marthasville na 1843 ma mesịa Atlanta na 1845, site na njikọ ụgbọ okporo ígwè ahụ ọ toro wee bụrụ isi ego na njem nke Ndịda Ọwụwa Anyanwụ US.

Akụkọ ihe mere eme nke obodo ahụ na-agafe n’isiokwu ndị na-akọwa Ndịda America. Obodo dị mkpa na Agha Obodo America, a gbara ya ọkụ n’oge mgbasa ozi Sherman nke 1864 ma wughachi ya dị ka obodo “New South”. Ọ ghọrọ etiti zuru ụwa ọnụ nke mmegharị ikike obodo — ebe amụrụ na ebe Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. si malite, onye Southern Christian Leadership Conference na Ebenezer Baptist Church ya dị na “Sweet Auburn” kwadoro ihe kpatara ya. Na 1996 obodo ahụ nabatara Summer Olympics, na-eme ka ọnọdụ ya dị na ogbo ụwa.

Atlanta bụkwa otu n’ime ahịa bọọlụ flagship nke MLS. Atlanta United FC, nke e guzobere na 2017, na-egwu na Mercedes-Benz Stadium ma na-eduga MLS na nkezi ndị na-abịa egwuregwu kwa oge kemgbe mmalite ya. Klọb ahụ setịpụrụ ndekọ ndị na-abịa MLS Cup nke 73,019 na 2018 MLS Cup, nke ọ meriri, ma wuo omenala ndị na-akwado ya n’ụzọ siri ike gburugburu otu dị ka Footie Mob, La Doce na All Stripes — ọkụ nke mere ka metro ahụ nweta aha Bleacher Report nke 2018 dị ka “Black Soccer Capital of America.”

Ihe nketa bọọlụ nke mpaghara ahụ na-agbatị karịa klọb nke ya. Metro ahụ nabatara 2024 Copa America mmeghe, ma ugbu a ọ na-eme egwuregwu asatọ nke 2026 World Cup, gụnyere ọkara ikpeazụ — ebe kwesịrị ekwesị maka obodo nke gbanwere obodo bọọlụ ka ọ bụrụ isi obodo bọọlụ.
